sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 1996
ACT
VI OF 1996
PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL
NAWABSHAH (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An
Act to amend the Medical College and Hospital, Nawabshah.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
26th February, 1996]
No.PAS/Legis.B-27/95,
dated 26-2-1996.---The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah
(Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 28th December, 1995 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 6th
February, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Act may be called the I People's Medical .College and Hospital Nawabshah
(Amendment) Act, 1995 .. .
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

VI OF 1996

NAWABSHAH (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1995
An
Act to amend the Medical College and Hospital, Nawabshah.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
26th February, 1996]
No.PAS/Legis.B-27/95,
dated 26-2-1996.---The People's Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah
(Amendment) Bill, 1995 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 28th December, 1995 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 6th
February, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
4. Amendment of section 18 of the Act of
1995.--In the said Act, for section 18 excluding the provisos, the
following shall be substituted and shall always be deemed to have been so
substituted:--
"
18. (1) The persons serving in the existing medical college and hospital in any
capacity immediately before the coming into force of this Act may opt to serve
in the Medical College;
(2) The option under subsection (1), shall be
made and submitted to Government within thirty days of the commencement of the
people's Medical College (Amendment) Act, 1995;
(3)
On receipt of option under subsection (2), Government may transfer the persons
concerned for service under the Medical college on such terms and conditions as
Government may determine;"
